what: Loading styled like model training — in a terminal panel a loss curve (.09 + 2.5e^(−3.4t) + small ripples) is drawn from the left while descending, with the endpoint following. Each time progress passes another 1/6, a ”[ OK ] epoch k/6 loss … acc …” line lights up with .18s steps(2) and stacks (max 6 lines). The bottom line’s step·tok/s·gpu values jitter and change, and while the cell bar fills, the stage name changes Loading → Training (8%) → Evaluating (88%) → Converged. When full, after 250ms the enter button turns on in .4s, and pressing it clears the panel in .45s and fires fx:enter (detail.sound)

options.dur: Length (s) from 0 to 100% when there is no other signal, default 2.5
options.steps: total number of step lines, default 6000
options.data-progress: When the host puts a 0–1 value into the panel (e.g. 3D scene loading progress), it follows that value using the original formula (1−e^(−dt/150) of the remaining share)
options.[data-fx-part=curve · dot · now]: Curve polyline · end-point circle · current loss number (polyline and circle inside one svg)
options.[data-fx-part=go]: Enter button group — the [data-sound within=Pressing on|off] fires fx:enter

note: Curve and accuracy formulas, log sentence type and stage boundaries are as in the original. The original follows the 3D room load progress (dataset.progress) and force-fills after a 30-second stall

from.where: index.html .rh-loader — original loader: loss curve of 120 points, 6 epoch lines, progress dt/2500 (after receiving /700) · 1−e^(−dt/350|150), enter after 250ms
